title: Production RDS should use Multi-AZ
rationale: Require explicit infrastructure evidence of this architecture control.
recommendation: Configure MultiAZ to satisfy this policy; use a dated exception when justified.

title: RDS should retain backups for at least seven days
rationale: Require explicit infrastructure evidence of this architecture control.
recommendation: Configure BackupRetentionPeriod to satisfy this policy; use a dated exception when justified.

title: RDS should enable deletion protection
rationale: Require explicit infrastructure evidence of this architecture control.
recommendation: Configure DeletionProtection to satisfy this policy; use a dated exception when justified.

title: S3 should enable versioning
rationale: Require explicit infrastructure evidence of this architecture control.
recommendation: Configure VersioningConfiguration.Status to satisfy this policy; use a dated exception when justified.

title: SQS should configure a dead-letter queue
rationale: Require explicit infrastructure evidence of this architecture control.
recommendation: Configure RedrivePolicy to satisfy this policy; use a dated exception when justified.

title: DynamoDB should enable point-in-time recovery
rationale: Require explicit infrastructure evidence of this architecture control.
recommendation: Configure PointInTimeRecoverySpecification.PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled to satisfy this policy; use a dated exception when justified.

title: DynamoDB should enable deletion protection
rationale: Require explicit infrastructure evidence of this architecture control.
recommendation: Configure DeletionProtectionEnabled to satisfy this policy; use a dated exception when justified.

title: Auto Scaling should maintain at least two instances
rationale: Organization policy heuristic; validate against workload needs.
recommendation: Configure MinSize to satisfy this policy; use a dated exception when justified.

title: ECS should maintain at least two tasks
rationale: Organization policy heuristic; validate against workload needs.
recommendation: Configure DesiredCount to satisfy this policy; use a dated exception when justified.

title: ElastiCache should enable automatic failover
rationale: Require explicit infrastructure evidence of this architecture control.
recommendation: Configure AutomaticFailoverEnabled to satisfy this policy; use a dated exception when justified.
